notes.title: About delay of update on JS Page
notes.notes:
We are sorry about delay of update. Currently we are relocating our physical address from South Korea to another country since end of last year. And our game development project is taking more time than we expected as this is our first time of releasing a game. We restarted our game project plan multiple times. Therefore update of JS Page is getting delayed.

We are expecting the update will be later of this year. The update content of JS Page will be the latest javascript engine and its frameworks. And we are expecting to put Rino.js website compiler as well. So you can compile html, javascript and css components to full static website.

Thank you

notes.title: About new update of JS Page and Price change
notes.notes:
Good day, everyone!

We have been very quiet since last time. We had some problems and it has been fixed since start of this year. From this year, we were working on prototype of games, building libraries for GUI and many other things. Since some libraries are done, we are planning to update JS Page soon. It will happen later in this year or next year after releasing some products.

We are dropping support for some languages and we are going to maintain only English, Korean and Japanese.

For the last, we are going to change the price of JS Page. We are going to raise the price in next month, October 24th in Korean time.

Thank you for reading this and have a good day.

notes.title: A small update without version change!
notes.notes:
Hi! ːsteamhappyː

We have a small update about current version v 1.0.2. And it won't affect how the program works so there won't be version changing like v 1.0.2 to v 1.0.3.

Changes
In script tags page in JS Page, we have found that "Write into HTML file" was adding class name. So now it won't add "jspg-script" class name (class="jspg-script").

Thank you for reading! ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: Update for JS Page v 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hi! Here's new update for JS Page v 1.0.2.

Changes

1. How we handle script tags has been updated. Now you can choose whether you want to write the script tags in head for only files from same directory or every script tags that has been added. The default is "On" so if you want to add all the script(including other file paths), you should change the "Only same directory" selection to "Off" in the left menu (left sidebar). For the last, the script tag's src will be converted into "./directory.../filename", if they are from same directory of the opened HTML file. This will help people who want to  export their HTML file on live web server.

Thank you for reading! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Update for JS Page v 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hi! Here's new update for JS Page v 1.0.1.

Changes

1, Drag and drop feature is added. Now you can drag and drop files. File droppable area will change their color if you drag your file on them. And dropping multiple files in script tag page will add multiple script tags without type.


2. Shortcut keys are added. If you leave your mouse pointer on a button, you can find how to control JS Page with your keyboard.

ctrl + r - Run JS
ctrl + p - Prettier Code/Prettier HTML
ctrl + s - Save
ctrl + shift +s - Save As
ctrl + o - Open JS file/HTML file
ctrl + n - New JS, HTML
ctrl + w - Show HTML page
ctrl + d - developer tool
ctrl + q - console window
F5 - Reload HTML Page


3. How JS Page start setup has been changed.

Old version of JS Page was showing content of EULA 2 times. But new version of JS Page shows EULA just once when you install JS Page from steam. So if you start JS Page for first time, it will ask you to select language only.

Thank you for reading! ːsteamhappyː
